rows.grounds: morphology: tam acc sg + ārādhya gerund; context brief: propitiation precedes dīkṣā. L1/L2 prose blank, so context marked uncertain.
morphology: tataḥ + tuṣṭāt abl sg + dīkṣām acc sg + āsādya gerund; brief: dīkṣā as grace's occasion, not cause.
morphology: fem acc sg -īm agreeing with dīkṣām; context brief: Śiva's initiation. L1/L2 prose blank; Śāṅkarī taken as Śiva-related, not Śaṅkara.
morphology: tatkṣaṇāt abl + vā + upabhogāt abl + vā; brief: timing of grace/realization. L1/L2 prose blank, so upabhoga rendered enjoyment/experience with uncertainty.
morphology: dehapātāt abl sg + śivam acc; context: at bodily death one reaches Śiva. L1/L2 prose blank; compound split marked.
morphology: optative 3sg √vraj; context: would go/reach Śiva. L1/L2 prose blank; optative sense retained.
